description:
Initialization only: Regret Constructive Insertion.
- Process: Test remaining tasks across prefix positions, completing uninserted tasks in ascending ID; the final scan may be partial at the evaluation limit.
- Selection: Fix the task with largest regret (best minus second-best scored position; regret is 0 when only one position was scored); tie-break: highest best score, then smaller task ID.
- Termination: Stop after full prefix built or evaluation limit reached; return best trial seen.
